source: Tardis Binance Futures BTCUSDT snapshots and trades, 2020-09-01
causal_alignment: liquidity state is lagged one 10-second bin before flow and contemporaneous midpoint response; predictive features use only information observable by the end of the decision bin

measurements.participation: absolute signed aggressive BTC divided by trailing five-minute median 10-second gross volume
measurements.immediate_impact: absolute contemporaneous 10-second midpoint return in bps; direct impact-law comparisons require nonzero signed flow
measurements.state: lagged spread in bps divided by displayed near-touch BTC
measurements.h36: impact susceptibility I/sqrt(participation) is larger in high versus low prior-stress states
measurements.h37: log-log impact exponent and quadratic log-impact curvature are larger in high prior-stress states
measurements.h38: a positive trailing one-minute change in the five-minute rolling impact exponent predicts future excursion
measurements.h41: signed impact retained after 60 seconds, relative to immediate impact and clipped to [-2,2], is larger in high prior-stress states; predictive permanence uses only episodes whose 60-second outcomes are already known

sampling: 10-second decisions, next-60-second maximum midpoint excursion, contiguous 60/20/20 split, training-only 95th percentile jump threshold
baseline: spread, total depth, imbalance, realized volatility, event rate, trade count, trade volume, signed trade imbalance
primary_gate: augmented test average-precision improvement greater than 0.02 and positive Brier improvement
direct_gate: positive mean high-minus-low effect with a strictly positive 95% interval from 1000 deterministic resamples of eligible 10-minute test blocks
h38_gate: positive Spearman correlation and strictly positive block-bootstrap interval for high-minus-low future excursion
interpretation: Any survivor requires unchanged replication on the independent 2024 official Binance day. Failure rejects only these implementations.
